title: Hearing on the citywide 911 outage in August 2026
summary: The City Council will examine a technical failure on August 18, 2026 that prevented about 1,700 calls from reaching the Bronx 911 call center, with roughly 400 callers unable to reach a dispatcher. The hearing will review the outage's causes, including a software update from Motorola, and look at past 911 and dispatch system failures as well as the City's ongoing Next Generation 911 upgrade, which officials now aim to complete by summer 2026. Witnesses invited include the Office of Technology and Innovation, NYPD and FDNY.
